title: Quartile: a meaning-preserving Q1 academic writing engine with a simulated review committee and statistics checks
description: Quartile checks business, management, finance and economics manuscripts without changing their science. A deterministic guard blocks any revision that adds or changes numbers, citations, protected constructs, names or causal claims. Version 0.17 adds a simulated pre-submission review committee (editor-in-chief, methods, finance and statistics, business administration, production, ethics and writing style), with rule-based findings that carry a rule ID, the exact text span, the source of the rule, a severity, a confidence and a fix; statistics checks (GRIM, GRIMMER, DEBIT, p-value recomputation) validated against R; a local reference library with APA 7 output; and an append-only paper-history record that turns approved editor and reviewer requests into checklist rules. Reviewer-role output is labelled as a simulated pre-submission review, not a journal decision. The MCP server exposes the checks to Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.
